headings.title: Creation and responsibilities of the division
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Division of Developmental Disabilities within the department to ensure accessible prevention, evaluation, care, habilitation, and rehabilitation services, supervise department facilities and programs, and oversee funded or licensed services.

headings.title: Powers, functions, and duties of the division
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates thirteen powers, functions, and duties of the division covering funding, plan review, technical assistance, quality standards, research, public information, coordination, volunteers, evaluation, and standards development.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 633.010 establishing the Division of Developmental Disabilities, its supervision/oversight role, and thirteen enumerated duties.

headings.title: Advisory council role and membership size
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Missouri Developmental Disabilities Council of up to twenty-five members under council bylaws to advise the division and division director.

headings.title: Council appointments, terms, and composition requirements
headings.reviewNote: Continues October 26, 1979 planning council members, requires director appointments for three-year terms, at least one-half consumers, one sheltered workshop representative under section 178.900, and caps contracted vendors over $1,500 at one-fourth with a not-for-profit board exception.

headings.title: Meetings and election of council chairman
headings.reviewNote: Requires meetings at least every ninety days or at the call of the division director or the council chairman elected by the council.

headings.title: Reimbursement of reasonable and necessary expenses
headings.reviewNote: Requires reimbursement of each member's reasonable and necessary expenses, including travel expenses under department travel regulations, actually incurred in official duties.

headings.title: Division of council into subcouncils
headings.reviewNote: Permits the council to be divided into subcouncils in accordance with its bylaws.

headings.title: State plan collaboration with department
headings.reviewNote: Requires the council to collaborate with the department in developing and administering a state plan for intellectual disabilities and developmental disabilities services.

headings.title: Conflict of interest restrictions and member removal
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits state advisory council members from participating in or influencing decisions involving direct involvement or income, making violation grounds for removal by the director.

headings.title: Advisory status and specific council duties
headings.reviewNote: States the council is advisory and enumerates four mandatory duties covering informational meetings, technology review, service delivery recommendations, and licensing or funding criteria.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 8 subsections for 633.020 and corrected five shifted/fabricated headings (3-6, 8) covering meetings, expense reimbursement, subcouncils, state plan collaboration, and advisory duties.

headings.title: Preparation and annual revision of state plan
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to prepare and annually revise a coordinated state plan for developmental disability services.

headings.title: Mandatory contents and elements of state plan
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required components of the state plan including needs assessments, goals, inventories, evaluations, and rules.

headings.title: Consideration of regional plans in preparation
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that the department take regional plans into consideration when preparing the statewide plan.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 633.030 governing preparation, mandatory contents, and regional plan consideration for the state developmental disabilities plan.

headings.title: Plan to address waitlist for services
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department of mental health to develop an eight-component plan for persons on service waitlists, including habilitation center residents awaiting community placement, to reduce waitlists over five years and waiting periods to ninety days.

headings.title: Annual completion deadline and legislative submission
headings.reviewNote: Requires completion on or before November first each year beginning November 1, 2007, and annual submission by the department director to the house speaker, senate president pro tem, and governor.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 633.032 requiring an eight-component service waitlist plan and annual November first submission beginning November 1, 2007.

headings.title: Joint plan for children needing services
headings.reviewNote: Requires the departments of mental health and social services to jointly prepare a plan for custody cases involving children solely needing mental health services without abuse, neglect, or abandonment, and children or persons seventeen years of age under section 211.181.1(5).

headings.title: Required funding and programmatic plan analyses
headings.reviewNote: Requires plan to analyze federal funding, waivers, budgetary impact, and feasibility of securing federal support.

headings.title: Completion deadline and submission to officials
headings.reviewNote: Requires plan completion on or before January 1, 2004, and submission by both department directors to the governor, senate president pro tem, and house speaker.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 633.033 governing a joint child and seventeen-year-old mental health service plan, required funding analyses, and January 1, 2004 deadline.

headings.title: Establishment and appointment of regional advisory councils
headings.reviewNote: Permits the department director to establish regional councils and requires the division director to appoint up to twenty regional residents to staggered three-year terms if a council is established.

headings.title: Consumer representation and vendor membership limitations
headings.reviewNote: Requires at least one-half consumer members and limits vendors over $1,500 to one-fourth, excluding not-for-profit corporation board members and deferring the vendor cap until September 28, 1985, for pre-August 13, 1980 regional center councils.

headings.title: Conflict of interest prohibition and removal grounds
headings.reviewNote: Bars regional members from participating in decisions involving personal interest or income and authorizes director removal.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 633.040 authorizing department director establishment of regional councils, division director appointments, composition limits, and conflict rules.

headings.title: Participation and contents of regional plans
headings.reviewNote: Requires regional councils to participate in preparing, reviewing, and recommending regional plans with inventories and goals.

headings.title: Appropriations condition for regional council staff
headings.reviewNote: Requires that any staff of regional advisory councils be provided only from funds appropriated specifically for that purpose, effective July 1, 1981.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 633.045 governing regional advisory council plan participation and specific-appropriation staff funding effective July 1, 1981.

headings.title: Regional center budget and program review
headings.reviewNote: Tasks regional councils with reviewing and advising on regional center policies, programs, and budgets prior to department submission.

headings.title: Advice on operations and service delivery
headings.reviewNote: Permits regional councils to advise the department, division, and regional centers on service delivery to minimize duplication, fragmentation, and unnecessary expenditures while requiring consideration of existing agencies and personnel.

headings.title: Family support plan duties and reporting
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates five specific council duties including stipend and loan disbursement, family support plan approval, and annual reporting.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 633.050 governing regional advisory council budget review, permissive operational advice, and five family support duties.

headings.title: Eligibility for diagnostic and counseling services
headings.reviewNote: Provides that any person suspected to have an intellectual or developmental disability is eligible for initial diagnostic and counseling services through regional centers.

headings.title: Regional center client registration and services
headings.reviewNote: Requires regional centers, upon comprehensive evaluation and client, parent, or guardian registration request, to secure necessary services within available resources across fourteen nonexclusive categories.

headings.title: Client involvement and written consent requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires client, family, or guardian involvement and written consent for care, treatment, habilitation, referral, or placement unless authorized by court order under chapter 475.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 633.110 governing initial diagnostic eligibility, regional center client services, and written consent requirements.

headings.title: Evaluation and referral by regional center
headings.reviewNote: Permits a regional center to refer a client for developmental disability facility admission only if a comprehensive evaluation establishes four statutory criteria, including inadequacy of less restrictive services.

headings.title: Forwarding evaluation and records to facility
headings.reviewNote: Requires the regional center to forward its comprehensive evaluation and necessary records so the developmental disability facility can decide whether to accept or reject the referral.

headings.title: Facility admission and rejection appeal process
headings.reviewNote: Permits a private facility head and requires a department facility head to admit an appropriate client if suitable accommodations exist, and permits the regional center to appeal a department facility rejection to the division director for disposition after consultation.

headings.title: Consent requirements for facility admission
headings.reviewNote: Requires consent to admission by the competent person, parent or legal custodian of a minor, or court-authorized guardian unless otherwise ordered by a court.

headings.title: Thirty-day individualized habilitation plan requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires the facility head to have an individualized habilitation plan within thirty days of admission stating anticipated length of stay and feasibility of least restrictive alternatives.

headings.title: Inapplicability to chapter 475 guardianship proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Exempts department developmental disability facility residents from this section's referral procedure if chapter 475 guardianship proceedings are initiated.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsections for 633.120 and corrected shifted/inaccurate headings for subsections 2 and 3 covering evaluation forwarding, private/department admission, and rejection appeals.

headings.title: Immediate discharge upon release request and exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Requires immediate discharge upon oral, written, or other release request by the applicant, except the facility head may initiate chapter 632 involuntary detention or any individual may initiate chapter 475 guardianship and emergency commitment if the resident presents a likelihood of serious harm.

headings.title: Discharge upon evaluation of nondisability and consent
headings.reviewNote: Requires discharge from a department facility if a comprehensive evaluation or periodic review finds the person is not intellectually or developmentally disabled and consent is obtained; without consent, requires section 633.135 appeal proceedings first.

headings.title: Discharge or placement in least restrictive environment
headings.reviewNote: Requires discharge or section 630.610 regional center referral for least restrictive placement under three criteria, barring discharge without consent unless section 633.135 proceedings are completed.

headings.title: Post-discharge referral to regional center
headings.reviewNote: Requires referral to an appropriate regional center after discharge under subsection 3 to assist in obtaining necessary services.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 633.125 governing discharge upon request, nondisability discharge, least restrictive environment placement, and post-discharge regional center referral.

headings.title: Mandatory periodic one hundred eighty-day review
headings.reviewNote: Requires facility head to evaluate condition of each resident at least every one hundred eighty days for habilitation need.

headings.title: Discharge or regional center placement initiation
headings.reviewNote: Requires the facility head to initiate discharge proceedings when continued residential habilitation is no longer appropriate, except the facility head may refer the resident to the regional center for section 630.610 placement.

headings.title: Transmittal of evaluation to court with jurisdiction
headings.reviewNote: Requires copies of periodic evaluation and individualized habilitation plan to be sent to any court with jurisdiction.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 633.130 governing 180-day periodic resident evaluations, discharge or regional center referral, and court transmittal.

headings.title: Facility head petition upon refusal of consent
headings.reviewNote: Permits the facility head to petition the division director when a resident, minor's parent, or legal guardian refuses consent to a proposed placement or discharge.

headings.title: Convening of three-member review panel
headings.reviewNote: Requires the division director to refer the petition to the state advisory council chairman to appoint a three-member review panel including at least one department-facility resident's parent or guardian and nongovernmental members, excluding department officers or employees.

headings.title: Panel hearing and department director final decision
headings.reviewNote: Requires an electronically recorded panel hearing forwarded with recommended findings and decision to the department director for an expedited final decision with notice by registered mail, return receipt requested.

headings.title: Expedited judicial review in circuit court
headings.reviewNote: Permits circuit court appeal within thirty days for expedited review under chapter 536 and burden-of-proof standards, allowing additional competent and material evidence for good cause shown.

headings.title: Probate court approval for unrepresented adult discharge
headings.reviewNote: Bars discharging a facility resident age eighteen or older without a legal guardian unless the probate division of the circuit court confirms the resident does not need the facility's care, treatment, or programs.

headings.title: Chapter 536 procedures for panel hearing
headings.reviewNote: Requires panel hearing notice and procedures to comply with chapter 536.

headings.title: Preponderance of evidence burden on facility head
headings.reviewNote: Places burden of proof by preponderance of evidence on facility head in all panel and circuit court proceedings.

headings.title: Prohibition on placement or discharge pending decision
headings.reviewNote: Bars placement or discharge pending panel convening and final director or court decision, except the department may temporarily transfer the resident in a medical emergency.

headings.title: Employee immunity from disciplinary action for testimony
headings.reviewNote: Protects state employees from disciplinary action for testifying or providing good faith evidence regarding placement.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 9 subsections for 633.135 and corrected subsection 3 title to reflect the department director's final decision in contested placement and discharge proceedings.

headings.title: Sheriff apprehension of unauthorized absent resident
headings.reviewNote: Requires sheriff to apprehend and return an unauthorized absent resident upon request of facility head.

headings.title: Conditions authorizing request for resident return
headings.reviewNote: Permits the facility head to request an absent resident's return only under four specified circumstances, requiring necessity determinations under subdivision (4) to be noted in the resident's records.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 633.140 governing sheriff apprehension of unauthorized absent residents and the four conditions permitting a return request.

headings.title: Department facility transfer criteria and grounds
headings.reviewNote: Permits the department to transfer a resident between department facilities when the division director determines it is desirable for improved habilitation or services, safety and welfare, or proximity to family and friends.

headings.title: Transfer restrictions to private facilities
headings.reviewNote: Restricts transfers to private developmental disability facilities to placements under section 630.610.

headings.title: Written determination, notice, and consent requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires written division director determinations in resident records, notice to the resident, guardian, or next of kin, and consent of the resident, guardian, or minor's parent before transfer.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 633.145 governing department facility transfers, private facility transfer limits, and written determination, notice, and consent rules.

headings.title: Duration and extension of respite care
headings.reviewNote: Permits the division to provide or obtain up to twenty-one days of respite care, extendable up to an additional twenty-one days for good cause, requiring express division director approval beyond forty-two days within a one-year period.

headings.title: Respite care admission for incapacitated persons
headings.reviewNote: Permits a regional center, notwithstanding sections 633.120 and 475.120, to admit a legally incapacitated person for up to twenty-one days of respite care without a court order for good cause shown.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 633.155 governing permissive respite care durations, division director approval beyond 42 days, and incapacitated-person respite admission.

headings.title: Regional center family support program outreach
headings.reviewNote: Requires regional centers to promote community awareness of family support programs and determine service eligibility.

headings.title: Administration of family support program by councils
headings.reviewNote: Directs regional advisory councils to administer family support programs using resources provided by regional centers.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 633.175 governing regional center family support outreach and regional advisory council program administration.

headings.title: Policies, procedures, and rules for family support
headings.reviewNote: Requires the division, in cooperation with the Missouri planning council for developmental disabilities, to adopt policies and procedures and, when necessary, promulgate rules on seven enumerated topics including grievance resolution.

headings.title: Rulemaking effectiveness under section 536.024
headings.reviewNote: Provides that no rule or portion of a rule promulgated under chapter 633 becomes effective unless promulgated pursuant to section 536.024.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 633.190 and corrected subsection 2 to remove a fabricated unconstitutionality clause not present in the section 536.024 rulemaking text.

headings.title: Definition of autism spectrum disorder
headings.reviewNote: Defines "autism spectrum disorder" for this section as having the same meaning as in the current Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders.

headings.title: Commission establishment, support, and meetings
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Missouri Commission on Autism Spectrum Disorders within the department of mental health, requires department support and at least four annual meetings, and permits telephone or video conference meetings.

headings.title: Autism Roadmap for Missouri mission and contents
headings.reviewNote: Tasks the commission with producing a lifespan "Autism Roadmap for Missouri" covering best practices, existing resources and funding, unmet needs, and policy, programmatic, legislative, and funding recommendations.

headings.title: Twenty-five member composition, terms, and expenses
headings.reviewNote: Establishes twenty-five commission members appointed by the department of mental health director (except department directors), four-year terms (two-year terms for autism center directors), vacancies, uncompensated service, and possible expense reimbursement; source note records "service" in original rolls for "services" in subdivision (12).

headings.title: Four phases of commission work
headings.reviewNote: Requires the commission to conduct its work in four phases covering transition to adulthood, early identification and intervention, access to care, and challenging behavior and crisis care.

headings.title: Phase reports and final summary submission
headings.reviewNote: Requires commission to submit reports upon completion of each phase and a final summary document to director and governor.

headings.title: Phase commencement schedule and annual deadlines
headings.reviewNote: Commences phase one on January 1, 2022, with consecutive annual phases completed by December thirty-first and reports due no later than the following April first.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 subsections for 633.200 and corrected shifted/hallucinated headings for subsections 1-4 (definition, commission creation, Autism Roadmap mission, 25-member composition) and preserved original-rolls footnote.

headings.title: Creation of Office of Autism Services
headings.reviewNote: Establishes Office of Autism Services within the division to provide leadership, program standards, and capacity coordination.

headings.title: Definition of autism spectrum disorder
headings.reviewNote: Defines autism spectrum disorder according to standard diagnostic criteria for pervasive developmental disorders.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 633.210 establishing the Office of Autism Services and defining autism spectrum disorder.

headings.title: Definitions of autism program terms
headings.reviewNote: Defines "autism", "division", "family support" (with six required characteristics), and "service provider" for purposes of this section.

headings.title: Establishment of autism programs and services
headings.reviewNote: Requires the division to establish autism programs and services in conjunction with persons with autism, families, regional parent advisory councils, and the Missouri parent advisory committee to build skills, teach behavioral supports, and provide family support.

headings.title: Division into at least five regions and boundaries
headings.reviewNote: Requires the division director, with input from the Missouri parent advisory council on autism, to divide the state into at least five regions contiguous to the extent practicable with political subdivisions and health service areas.

headings.title: Authorized regional project services and therapies
headings.reviewNote: Permits regional projects to provide or purchase fourteen enumerated services in addition to other contemporary and emerging practices.

headings.title: Composition of regional parent advisory councils
headings.reviewNote: Establishes regional parent advisory councils composed of persons with autism and family members, excluding providers.

headings.title: Responsibilities of regional parent advisory councils
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates ten council duties including advocacy, contract monitoring, audit reviews, service priorities, and planning.

headings.title: Establishment of parent advisory committee on autism
headings.reviewNote: Establishes Missouri parent advisory committee on autism composed of regional representatives and individuals with autism.

headings.title: Diversity and appointment of nominated members
headings.reviewNote: Directs division director to appoint regional council nominees representing statewide cultural and capability diversity.

headings.title: Responsibilities of Missouri parent advisory committee
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates five committee responsibilities including council liaison, outcome metrics, statewide activities, and reporting.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking and chapter 536 nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department of mental health director to promulgate implementing rules subject to chapter 536, section 536.028 if applicable, and nonseverability for rules proposed or adopted after August 28, 2009.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 10 subsections for 633.220 and corrected shifted/inaccurate headings for subsections 1-3 (definitions, autism programs establishment, and five-region division).

headings.title: Applicability of federal and state facility laws
headings.reviewNote: Subjects all group homes and developmental disability facilities to applicable federal and state laws and monitoring.

headings.title: Training requirements for mental health workers
headings.reviewNote: Requires mental health workers in group homes to undergo comparable state worker training paid for by the employer.

headings.title: Medical error reporting requirements for facilities
headings.reviewNote: Applies uniform medical error reporting requirements to group homes and developmental disability facilities.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking and nonseverability with chapter 536
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to promulgate or amend rules subject to chapter 536, section 536.028 if applicable, and nonseverability for rules proposed or adopted after August 28, 2008.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 633.300 governing group home law applicability, worker training, medical error reporting, and chapter 536 rulemaking.

headings.title: Facility annual staff turnover reporting requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires all mental health facilities, beginning January 1, 2009, to submit annual staff turnover reports (number, job description, salary, duration) to the department within thirty days after each calendar year.

headings.title: Department annual turnover report to general assembly
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department, beginning January 1, 2009, to collect subsection 1 reports and submit facility-specific and aggregate turnover reports to the general assembly on or before March fifteenth each year.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 633.306 governing annual mental health facility staff turnover reports and department reporting to the general assembly beginning January 1, 2009.

headings.title: Definitions of statutory assessment terms
headings.reviewNote: Defines health benefit services, intermediate care facilities, net operating revenues, and facility services.

headings.title: Assessment on intermediate care facility revenues
headings.reviewNote: Imposes, beginning July 1, 2008, an assessment on net operating revenues of intermediate care facility providers for the privilege of providing services in Missouri.

headings.title: Formula for facility assessment determination
headings.reviewNote: Provides that facility assessments are based on formulas set forth in department rules and regulations.

headings.title: Medicaid rate reimbursement and federal approvals
headings.reviewNote: Designates assessments as reimbursable costs under Medicaid rates contingent upon necessary federal financial participation.

headings.title: Monthly submission and payable to revenue director
headings.reviewNote: Requires monthly submission of assessments to department director and payment to director of revenue.

headings.title: Alternative state payment offset authorization
headings.reviewNote: Permits providers to direct department of social services to offset monthly assessment amounts from state payments.

headings.title: Creation of reimbursement allowance fund and nonreversion
headings.reviewNote: Creates dedicated reimbursement allowance fund in state treasury with investment earnings retention and nonreversion.

headings.title: Provider recordkeeping and monthly cash reports
headings.reviewNote: Requires providers to keep liability records and, commencing July 1, 2008, submit monthly cash-basis reports to the department of social services within forty-five days of month end.

headings.title: Certified annual report of net operating revenues
headings.reviewNote: Requires providers to submit certified annual revenue reports and pay final annual assessments upon submission.

headings.title: Prescription of document forms and contents
headings.reviewNote: Directs director of mental health to prescribe by rule the form and content of required assessment filings.

headings.title: Delinquency notification and state payment withholding
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director of social services, upon delinquency notice from the director of mental health, to withhold and remit an estimated assessment amount to the director of revenue from state payments.

headings.title: Administrative hearings on assessment determinations
headings.reviewNote: Permits a provider to request a hearing, requires an opportunity to be heard within thirty days and final director decision within forty-five days of completion, and directs appeals to the administrative hearing commission under sections 208.156 and 621.055.

headings.title: Circuit court original jurisdiction for assessment appeals
headings.reviewNote: Directs assessment appeals to the circuit court of Cole County or the county where the facility is located as the court of original jurisdiction.

headings.title: Preservation of tax-exempt and nonprofit status
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that assessment provisions do not affect or limit tax-exempt or nonprofit status of facilities.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking and nonseverability with chapter 536
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department of mental health director to promulgate implementing rules subject to chapter 536, section 536.028 if applicable, and nonseverability after August 28, 2008.

headings.title: Statutory expiration date of September 30, 2029
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the provisions of this section expire on September 30, 2029; source note records "Expires 9-30-29".

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 16 subsections for 633.401 and broadened subsection 13 title to include facility-county circuit court original jurisdiction alongside Cole County.

headings.title: Definition of dyslexia and assessment clarifications
headings.reviewNote: Defines "dyslexia" for this section, clarifies districts are not prohibited from assessing students or offering specialized reading instruction, and states the definition does not automatically require disability eligibility or an IEP unless federal conditions are met.

headings.title: Establishment of Legislative Task Force on Dyslexia
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Legislative Task Force on Dyslexia with joint committee on education support (chairman approval required for monetary expenses), quarterly meetings (telephone or video permitted), and advisory duties to the governor, joint committee, and relevant state agencies.

headings.title: Composition and qualifications of task force members
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates twenty-one members including legislators, education commissioner, specialists, therapists, and citizens; source footnotes note "twenty" in original rolls of S.B. 635 and S.B. 638, "Therapists" for "Therapy" in (12), and "Board" for "Boards'" in (19).

headings.title: Appointment procedures, vacancies, and uncompensated service
headings.reviewNote: Requires alternating non-legislative/non-ex-officio appointments by the senate president pro tempore and house speaker by September 1, 2016, member-selected chairperson, vacancy filling, and uncompensated service.

headings.title: Task force recommendations and reporting deadlines
headings.reviewNote: Tasks the body with recommending identification systems and submitting a report within twelve months of first meeting.

headings.title: Mandatory focus areas for task force recommendations
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates six specific focus areas including screening tools, evidence-based reading instruction, and professional training.

headings.title: Hiring or contracting for specialist services
headings.reviewNote: Requires the task force to hire or contract for specialist services as necessary using general assembly appropriations to the joint committee on education or other available funding.

headings.title: Statutory expiration date of August 31, 2018
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the task force expires on August 31, 2018, unless reauthorized by an act of the general assembly; source note records "Expires 8-31-18".

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 8 subsections for 633.420, corrected subsection 1 (definition, not legislative findings) and subsection 7 (mandatory shall), and preserved all three original-rolls footnotes and the expiration source note.
